blurb: Guests fish for wild lake trout, rainbow trout, brown trout, and bass on Caspian Lake and nearby lakes. The captain is US Coast Guard licensed and provides guided fishing experiences with catch and release policy. Trips include use of a Key West 1720 center console boat equipped with sonar and trolling motor.
extraNote: $100 deposit required to book trip, payable by cash, check, Venmo, or PayPal · Full refund or reschedule if cancelled 14 or more days before trip · No refund on deposit if cancelled 13 or fewer days before trip, deposit can be used toward reschedule · No shows lose deposit and no reschedule · Inflatable life jackets required when water temperature below 50°F · Caspian Lake public beach and boat ramp, or pickup anywhere on the lake with prior arrangement
